description:
Transform groups of geometric primitives into single custom vector shapes using Boolean operations. 

1. On Slide 1 (Server Asset), select all shapes (rectangle and circles) and use 'Shapes > Subtract' to create a server icon with cutouts.
2. On Slide 2 (Cloud Asset), select all shapes (circles) and use 'Shapes > Union' to merge them into a single cloud shape.
3. Save the presentation.
